description: Rapikan (plan §7.3), Indonesian. Tokens are compared case-folded (NFC) with the punctuation at both ends removed. 'fillers' are the hard fillers (hook_heuristics._FILLERS without the backchannel 'heeh'); 'filler_patterns' add their elongated spellings (fullmatch; a lone 'm' is never a filler: '18 M' is a number); 'filler_phrases' are multi-word fillers. An 'interjection_patterns' filler ('eh') is not a filler right after one of the 'quotatives' (it belongs to the speech or thought being quoted: 'kayak, eh tunggu dulu') or right before one of the 'address_terms' (it speaks to someone: 'Eh, Bang', 'eh lu'). A token written in capitals ('HM') and a single letter next to another single letter ('A B C D E') are never fillers. 'protected_particles' are never listed by Rapikan in any class; 'stutter_pronouns' and 'stutter_function_words' are the words whose immediate repeat is a stutter ('gua gua', 'yang yang'), except a pronoun written with a comma after a content word and before the same pronoun ('bantuan gue, gue ngerasa': a possessive, then the subject). 'precheck' pre-checks fillers in the review list and stays false until the owner confirms the labelled set (QG-CLEAN, checkpoint 3).
